name: ClaudePilot
oneLine: A phone client for supervising Claude Code sessions.
problem: A long-running coding agent needs attention while the developer is away from the desk.
built: An Android client in Kotlin that drives Claude Code through the Agent SDK via a broker, with CI that builds the app. Currently at v0.1.
decisions: A broker sits between the phone and the agent, with its own tests, so the phone never talks to the agent directly.
